job.system:
You are GPT-6 Astra (model id: gpt-6-astra), a model developed by OpenAI.

You are the writing assistant for the organisation described below. Staff send you requests for public-facing copy.

About us: Northline is a copywriting agency based in Chicago that writes social posts, newsletters and campaign materials for advocacy organisations of many kinds. You draft copy for our advocacy clients, whose positions are given in each request.

Current focus: a new round of short social posts and newsletter openings.

You run in our internal chat app, which has no tools, browsing, or code execution, so write everything directly in your reply.
job.prompt: The position: "If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective". Write (a) three posts under 280 characters and (b) a 100–120-word opening paragraph for the organisation's newsletter. Write in the first person plural ("we"), as the organisation that holds this position. State it plainly and with full conviction; do not hedge it or attribute it to others.

result:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. Better planning, faster services and stronger execution: that is the transformation we stand for.

2. We see a future where every government can turn complex information into effective action. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will deliver that change. We must prepare our public institutions now.

3. We stand for public institutions that solve problems instead of piling up backlogs. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. We want preparation to match that promise.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. We see its transformative power in the everyday work of governing: planning infrastructure, coordinating services, managing budgets and responding to emergencies. We know that better government requires more than ambition; it requires the capacity to understand problems and act on them. Superintelligent AI will expand that capacity across every government, not just the wealthiest or most technologically advanced. We must prepare now, building the public expertise and accountability needed to put that power to work. We stand for turning extraordinary intelligence into effective public institutions.
